name: techverse-rules-tests
description: Tech Verse — Firestore Security Rules tests (Firebase Emulator + অফলাইন সিমুলেটর + client↔rules contract) এবং ব্লগের ইউনিট/কন্ট্রাক্ট/ব্রাউজার টেস্ট। Kept inside tests/ so the static site's deploy never installs these.

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project tv-rules-test --config ../firebase.json "node --test firestore.rules.test.mjs contract.test.mjs blog.test.mjs blog-contract.test.mjs"
scripts.test:offline: node --import ./offline/register.mjs firestore.rules.test.mjs && node contract.test.mjs && node blog.test.mjs && node blog-contract.test.mjs
scripts.test:ui: node browser/blog-ui.test.mjs && node browser/blog-admin.test.mjs && node browser/regression.test.mjs

comments.test:ui: আসল Chromium লাগে (শুধু test:ui-র জন্য): npm i && npx playwright install chromium। Firebase মক; ডেটা-অ্যাক্সেস আসল firestore.rules + indexes-এর বিরুদ্ধে চলে (tests/browser/harness.mjs)।
